name: AI Session Experience
description: Lets a person work with the AI while it works, from a terminal, a chat page or a task modal: watch each step and helper as it happens, stop at once and resume, send a correction and see it taken up, approve or refuse a risky step, and read the result, all through one event and control contract that any harness satisfies.
purpose: Let a person watch, steer, stop and resume the AI while it works, and understand and trust what it did, on any surface and with any harness.
approach: Draw typed events from the run and send typed controls back, so one screen serves every harness and every surface; show only what the run reports, mark what it does not, and keep detail one action away.
out_of_scope: How a run is answered (the front door), how a block is worded and drawn (the terminal blocks), what a harness does to the work, a consumer's settings and data model, and any screen that needs a UI library.
milestones: 1. Let a person work with the AI while it works on any surface and harness: the requirements of docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md that a scripted session can show are met on the hub's loop and on a stream session (authoritative metric metric-terminal-session). 2. A consumer's terminal, chat and task modal draw from the same events and controls.
knowledge: Placement against siblings: Request Intake takes in what people ask (before a run), Judgment Calls decides whether to ask (a decision, not a screen), Prioritization orders what reaches the person, Representatives carry a person's authority, and Feedback Learning edits specs from feedback; none draws a run for a person or takes a stop, steer or approval while it works, so this is the one Consciousness solution for the experience. It widens Terminal Session (same id, same Conversing interface plus attend) because the plain terminal is the reference surface of the same job; a sibling solution would duplicate its metric and its arms. Compared with Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, Aider and others on 2026-11-10 (registry area terminal_agent_experience).
measures_of_success: Share of scripted sessions right: stop then resume loses nothing, a steer is taken up in the next call and shown, helpers show with their parent, a risky step waits, the same script passes on two harnesses.
inputs: A harness (start and control), a goal, a text stream, optional key source; or lines and a front door for converse.
outputs: The text written, and a SessionReport (last Finished, every run, all events, the controls and whether each was taken).
effects: Runs the harness in a thread, reads keys (Escape, Ctrl-C, lines), writes to the stream it is given, and redraws in place only on a terminal.
usage_notes: Contract: hubofhubs/the_consciousness/terminal/session_events.py. Demo with no model: python -m hubofhubs.the_consciousness.terminal.live --demo loop. Requirements and research: docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md.
change_driver: how people want to talk to the hub from a terminal
